effect.name: Refract
effect.description: Bends the background as it passes through the object, using the object's own shading as the lens. Draw a bubble, a bottle, a heat pocket or a pane of glass, apply this, and the world behind it warps.
effect.author: CyberMushroom

parameter.name: Tint Colour
parameter.description: Colour the refracted background is stained with.

parameter.name: Strength
parameter.description: How far the background is pushed, in texels. Negative bends the other way.

parameter.name: Magnify
parameter.description: Scales the background inside the lens. Positive magnifies, negative shrinks.

parameter.name: Tint
parameter.description: How strongly the tint colour stains what shows through.

parameter.name: Keep Sprite
parameter.description: How much of the object's own art stays visible on top of the refraction. 0 is invisible glass.
